text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
The Milers Cup is 1,600 meters! It's the 
same distance as the Oka Sho, so I want to 
put on an even more wonderful run than 
back then.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Because if I do, I'm sure it'll open up a 
whole new future for you too, Trainer...!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Zephyr-san was so intensely focused. 
I'm... fully fired up too!
